title: Resume2Schema — Convert messy PDF resumes into strict JSON
problemStatement: Convert unstructured PDF or plain-text resumes into validated JSON Resume schema in under 1 second without manual copy-pasting.

formSchema.name: resumeText
formSchema.label: Paste raw resume snippet
formSchema.defaultValue: Aanya Sharma | B.Tech CSE 2026 | Built distributed PDF parser in Rust (12k req/s)

title: CSV Surgeon — Fix broken encodings, dedupe rows & emit SQL DDL
problemStatement: Clean corrupted CSV exports with mixed date formats, duplicate rows, and broken UTF-8 characters, and output ready-to-run Postgres DDL.

title: EnvDoctor — Detect missing, leaked, or mismatched .env keys across monorepos
problemStatement: Scan project .env.example files and source references to catch missing environment variables and accidental secret patterns before deployment.

title: CronSpeak — Turn natural English schedules into tested cron + systemd timers
problemStatement: Translate plain English scheduling rules like 'every weekday at 9:15am IST except bank holidays' into cron expressions with next-10 firing timestamps.

formSchema.name: scheduleText
formSchema.label: Describe when the job should run
formSchema.defaultValue: Every Monday and Thursday at 9:30 AM IST

title: VectorDiet — Interactive SVG path simplifier & React component generator
problemStatement: Shrink bloated Figma/Illustrator SVG exports by up to 80% while previewing visual fidelity side-by-side and copying accessible React components.

title: LedgerPing — Extract line items from freelance invoices & draft polite reminders
problemStatement: Parse overdue PDF/email invoices into structured due dates and generate polite, context-aware payment follow-up drafts automatically.

formSchema.name: invoiceSummary
formSchema.label: Invoice line & due date
formSchema.defaultValue: INV-204 • Landing page redesign • $650 • Due 14 days ago
